title: The US OCC denies Dutch fintech Bunq's application for a national bank charter, citing the need for more clarity on its business plan to expand in the US (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: The US OCC denies Dutch fintech Bunq's application for a national bank charter, citing the need for more clarity on its business plan to expand in the US — A US banking regulator turned down a charter application by Dutch financial-technology firm Bunq BV, which submitted a request …
